name: cavemio-testimonials
title: Testimonials
description: One quote, chosen by its people: faces step forward, the words cross-fade through a blur, a ring keeps time.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The faces are a radio group labelled with each name and role; arrow keys, Home and End move between people.
- Without autoplay the quote is a polite live region, so a new choice is read out; with autoplay it stays quiet.
- The ring timer is a CSS animation that pauses with play-state, so nothing re-renders while it runs.
- Installs Text morph alongside it. With reduced motion, quotes change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: Choose a face
features.description: The chosen face steps forward in full colour while the others step back.

features.title: The quote cross-fades
features.description: The old words blur away, the new ones rise in, the block eases to their height and the name morphs.

features.title: Autoplay with a ring
features.description: A thin ring draws around the chosen face as the timer, and pauses when you point at it.

features.title: Photos are optional
features.description: Without an avatar, tinted initials stand in.

features.title: A real radio group
features.description: Faces are labelled with each name and role, and arrow keys, Home and End move between people.

features.title: Quiet when it should be
features.description: Without autoplay a new choice is read out. With autoplay it stays silent, so it never talks over a reader.

states.title: choose
states.description: The chosen face scales to full and full colour; the others step back to 88%, faded and greyed.

states.title: change
states.description: Old words lift and blur away, new ones rise in (520ms) while the block eases to their height; the name morphs and the role fades in.

states.title: autoplay
states.description: A 1.25px ring draws around the chosen face over the interval, then the next person speaks. Pointer or focus inside pauses it.
